_meta.description: Measure each row's distance to a benchmark profile with ATTR_VEC_DISTANCE on experiment.pulse, averaged per treatment arm. The named vector spend (revenue_before, revenue) declares kind measure, so gap_std takes the measure distance default, std_euclidean: each difference is divided by that member's standard deviation from a fit over the filtered rows (ATTR_MAHALANOBIS's fit pass — two-pass, listwise, weighted when a weight is set), so members on different units compare. gap_mahal reads the fit's inverse covariance (mahalanobis, every member needed) and fits only on the control arm (fit_on) while scoring every row. gap_abs is the row-local manhattan distance over inline fields, single pass. A distance metric's sum is rescaled by p / p_observed when a member is null; a row with fewer than min_valid complete pairs is null.
_meta.name: attr_vec_distance
